title: 第21章 以货易货第22章 闲情逸致
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
捕头杨威站在最前，眼神锐利地扫视着人群。
店铺门前，钟源和钟进兄弟俩紧握刀柄，面色铁青，眼中怒火几乎要喷出来。
若非钟财死死挡在他们身前，陪着笑脸与领头几个闹得最凶的人周旋解释，只怕兄弟俩早已拔刀砍人了。
而百修楼另一侧，沈府大门也被几辆平板车堵住。
负责府门值守的钟进同样气得握紧了刀柄，若非小不忍则乱大谋，他也想冲过去砍人。
“钟进大哥！
钟进大哥！
少爷有吩咐！”
小跑而来的陈静，气喘吁吁地朝府门前的钟进喊道。
她本想走百修楼后门，去找钟财，结果发现后门也被迫关上了，只能绕道府门。
“少爷有何吩咐？”
钟进闻言眼睛顿时大亮。
陈静飞快地将沈算的吩咐复述给钟进听。
钟进虽年轻，但心思还算活络，立刻明白了少爷的用意——这是要釜底抽薪，化被动为主动，还要借衙役的势！
“好！
我知道了！”
钟进点头，示意陈静关上府门。
随即，他深吸一口气，眼中寒光一闪！
“嘭！
！”

一声巨响！
堵在沈府正门前的平板车，被他势大力沉的一脚狠狠踹开！
沉重的板车当即偏移撞在另一辆板车上，引得堵在百修楼门口的人群齐齐骇然回头！
只见钟进手握刀柄，浑身气势勃发，如同出笼猛虎，大步流星朝着百修楼铺门走去！
他每一步踏在青石板上都发出沉闷的“嘭嘭”
声，仿佛巨兽过境，七品炼筋大成武者的压迫感毫无保留地释放开来！
“嘶……七品大成？！”
人群中有人倒吸一口冷气，惊呼出声。
钟进走到店铺台阶下，在钟源、钟财等人身前站定，目光如电扫过闹哄哄的人群，运足中气，声若洪钟：
“少爷有令！
content_en:
The head catcher Yang Wei stood at the front, scanning the crowd with sharp eyes.
In front of the shop, brothers Zhong Yuan and Zhong Jin were holding the handles of their knives tightly, their faces livid, and the anger in their eyes almost burst out.
If Zhong Cai hadn't stood in front of them, accompanying Smiley and explaining to the leaders who made the most noise, the two brothers would have drawn their swords to kill them.
On the other side of Baixiu Building, the gate of Shen Mansion was also blocked by several flatbed trucks.
Zhong Jin, who was in charge of guarding the mansion, was also so angry that he clenched the handle of his knife. If it wasn't for his impatience, it would mess up his big plan. He also wanted to rush over and kill someone.
"Brother Zhong Jin!
Brother Zhong Jin!
The young master has orders! "
Chen Jing, who was trotting over, panted and shouted to Zhong Jin in front of the mansion.
She originally wanted to go through the back door of Baixiu Building to find Zhong Cai, but found that the back door was also forced to close, so she had to take a detour to the mansion.
"What are your orders, Master?"
Zhong Jin's eyes suddenly lit up when he heard this.
Chen Jing quickly repeated Shen Suan's instructions to Zhong Jin.
Although Zhong Jin was young, he was still quick-witted, and he immediately understood the young master's intention - he wanted to draw out the firepower, turn passivity into initiative, and also use the power of the Yamen servants!
"Okay!
I got it! "
Zhong Jin nodded and motioned for Chen Jing to close the door.
Immediately, he took a deep breath and a cold light flashed in his eyes!
“Bang!
! "
A loud bang!
The flatbed truck blocked in front of the main entrance of Shen Mansion was kicked away by him with a powerful kick!
The heavy cart immediately deflected and hit another cart, causing the crowd blocking the entrance of Baixiu Building to turn around in shock!
I saw Zhong Jin holding the handle of the knife, his whole body full of momentum, like a tiger out of the cage, striding towards the door of Baixiu Tower!
Every step he took on the bluestone made a dull "bang bang" sound.
The sound was like a giant beast crossing the border, and the oppressive feeling of a seventh-level muscle-refining master was released without reservation!
"Hiss...Seventh-grade Dacheng?!"
Someone in the crowd gasped and exclaimed.
Zhong Jin walked to the steps of the shop and stood in front of Zhong Yuan, Zhong Cai and others. His eyes swept across the noisy crowd like lightning, and with full energy, he sounded like a bell:
"Young Master has an order!
